title: 14 Million Enterprises' AI Colleague Goes Live: WorkBuddy Is Added to Contacts, Task and Output Directly Sent Back to Enterprise WeChat by Checking in Group Chats

content_html:
On October 14, Tencent WorkBuddy announced a deep integration with Enterprise WeChat. The WorkBuddy client can now call ten capabilities such as messages, documents, meetings, and micro-drives within the scope of enterprise authorization, and it has been added to the Enterprise WeChat contact list as a chatbot. Users can directly issue commands in chats.

This feature is available for verified enterprises. WorkBuddy needs to be upgraded to version 5.8.0 or higher, and Enterprise WeChat needs to be upgraded to version 5.0.12 or higher. It must be enabled by administrators in the background.

In terms of specific capabilities, WorkBuddy can categorize unread messages and emails from Enterprise WeChat into three types: "To Handle," "To Pay Attention To," and "Other," and summarize them along with action items. Users can select work messages in Enterprise WeChat groups and forward them to WorkBuddy, where the system automatically identifies online documents, micro-drive files, schedules, to-do lists, meetings, and smart minutes referenced. The input box can also directly reference micro-drive files from Enterprise WeChat, or issue commands for the Buddy to send messages or share products to private or group chats, with confirmation required by the user before sending.

The WorkBuddy robot within Enterprise WeChat synchronizes context between the app and the desktop, allowing users to switch between them while continuing the conversation. Scheduled tasks and message push switches allow tasks to be executed on time and results to be automatically pushed back. In the document library, users can directly @ and invite Enterprise WeChat members to collaborate.

Enterprises can manage account allocation, permission settings, and usage through the background. Operations such as viewing meeting content or searching and reading emails require employee authorization, and WorkBuddy will only perform actions within the authorized scope. Currently, Enterprise WeChat covers over 14 million real enterprises and organizations, serving 750 million WeChat users. This update connects Tencent's connectivity capabilities with WorkBuddy's task execution capabilities, allowing enterprises to avoid switching platforms or migrating data. AI agents are beginning to be embedded into existing office workflows.
